# Independent audit of sampled Ball-body dilation obstructions

Audited `candidate 8e4d516f7549d7b5`, including every
displayed finite certificate and the fixed-dimension limit. The audit passes.

The ray integral has the correct factor: the coefficient k^d cancels the
d-th power of the projective radial scaling 1/k. Thus the nonunit-vector
gauge is I(v)^(-1/d), and membership in aB is exactly a^d I(v)>=1.
The equality of the three integer fibers follows from equal endpoint
coefficients in every convex representation at base one. All fibers have
positive volume, and the initial anchor is an actual mixed point.

For epsilon=1/16 the two ray parameters at the displayed midpoint are
32/47 and 1/8. Their squared sum is 67745/141376<1/2. Raising either
base to any real exponent d>=2 only decreases it, proving the claimed
integer-dimensional certificate. For the planar factor-two example,
the candidate vertical point is inside B because 49601/48400>1;
the convex-combination point has I=16301/67600<1/4.

In the limiting family, the transverse coordinate of p_epsilon is
sqrt(epsilon), while its last coordinate tends to R_0>2. Consequently
the cube ray is 1/y_epsilon for all sufficiently small epsilon. The
thin box transverse ray sqrt(epsilon) is eventually smaller than its
vertical ray, which tends to the strictly positive number 2/R_0.
Hence the displayed exact integral and limit of its gauge follow.
The conclusion is a necessary lower bound on a possible uniform
constant; no existence or optimality assertion is implicit.

The strict-compatibility planar example also checks: the midpoint
rectangle's maximum diamond gauge is 511/600<1, and the radial
integral at its displayed witness is 641/1600<1/2. The closing
distinction between arbitrary anchors and required deepest anchors
is accurate and necessary.

The independent exact verifier
`supporting computation verify_sampled_ball_dilation_obstruction.py` was rerun successfully.
No mathematical defect or missing boundary condition was found.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
